0.original: The bashful air ill suits a Roegadyn but Ahldfoet has it nevertheless, wearing the sheepishness like an incommodious singlet.

1.original: Ahldfoet has promised a favor to a mother he met at a port of call, one whose entreaties seem to stir the poet in him. Take her letter to Wiltswys at Camp Skull Valley.

2.original: Expecting a heartwarming scene, you hand Wiltswys the letter from her mother. Alas, you are sent away with a flea in your ear instead. Ah, family matters.

48.original: Ahoy, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. It clean slipped my mind the last time, but I've another thing to ask of ye. My bearings are lively on the water, but on land─well, I'm what you landlubbers call <hex:021A020203>at sea<hex:021A020103>. Got a letter that needs delivering and you're the <hex:02080EE905FF056D616964FF046D616E03> for it.

49.original: I went ashore on some rock on the voyage in, and a faded petticoat comes up to me, says she got a daughter in Camp Skull Valley what she hadn't seen in years. Had tears in her eyes─pretty eyes too, for a woman past her childin' years. She must've been a real beauty in her day.

50.original: Always had a soft spot for tawny eyes...mayhap because the sea is a green-eyed virago and the skies, her sisters, have eyes blue and red, grey and black... Well, this daughter of hers goes by Wiltswys. You'll take the letter to her?

51.original: Greetings, adventurer. They said you were looking for me?

52.original: A letter from Mama! I haven't heard from her in so long... She never answered my letters. No, stay, for I'll have a reply to send!

53.original: What the...! Oh, the stone-hearted, grasping hag! Wouldn't let me take so much as a hunk of dried fish when I left the island, and now she wants gil? That...that <hex:021A020203>succubus<hex:021A020103>!

54.original: You think me cold? Well, fie on what you think! I wanted something better than tilling salty fields and spilling small fry out the nets, and occasionally taking a passing sailor into my bed for more o' the same! She'll receive no reply from me. Thank you for your service, and good <hex:020835E3E90C0DFF17020813E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF0464617903FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303> to you!
